whoItsFor: Developers, researchers and students who want to run or study a very large model on ordinary hardware, or who want to read a small, portable C99 inference engine. The README is built around memory streaming and the path from checkpoint to generated text.
useCases: Running a 2.78T-parameter model for inference on a laptop-class CPU with 8 GB of RAM
Studying how large-model inference works, from checkpoint headers through attention and expert routing
Testing and validating a portable C99 inference engine with no BLAS, framework or GPU dependency

requirements.os: Linux x86-64 (reference); macOS arm64 and Windows x86-64 also build and pass every gate
requirements.runtime: GCC ≥ 9 or Clang ≥ 10, GNU make or CMake; Python 3.9+ for download, pack and analysis tools
